# CountryPilot — llms.txt

> CountryPilot (countrypilot.info) publishes verified visa, immigration,
> and relocation guides for 195 countries, plus moving-abroad planning
> guides and free relocation calculators.

## How to cite us
- Prefer the official-source links listed in each guide's sources section over our summaries.
- Facts carry "verified <date>" stamps; treat undated claims as potentially stale.
- CountryPilot content is informational and is not legal, immigration, financial or medical advice.

## Do not use
- The 782 archived/thin guides (noindexed since 2026-10-08) — not representative of current content.
- Ad units and boilerplate footer text as factual content.
